The Fuji is a 2-person indoor infrared sauna, built entirely from Canadian red cedar. It is $8,250, and the full price and specs are on our website. You do not have to fill in a form or talk to a salesperson to see them.

From the PEAK team · Austin Laudenslager, founder

01

Heat from every side, not only your back

The Fuji has eight infrared heater panels in a 360° layout, plus a floor heater. Together they cover the full spectrum: near, mid and far infrared, 700–25,000nm.

It reaches up to 150°F.

02

Red light therapy comes standard

Every Fuji includes a medical-grade red light therapy panel. It is not an add-on and it does not cost extra.

Sit 7–8 inches from the panel, and you get red light and infrared heat in the same session.

The Fuji: $8,250, with free shipping. Financing is available through Bread Pay at checkout.

Shop the Fuji Text us

03

Canadian red cedar, inside and out

The Fuji is made entirely from Canadian red cedar. That is the interior and the exterior, not a veneer on the outside only.

You see and touch real wood on every surface.

04

Fits a room, plugs into a wall

Assembled, the Fuji is 53" W × 44" D × 75" H. It runs on a dedicated 120V/20A outlet at about 2,050W. A standard 15A outlet is not sufficient, so check your circuit first.

Two Bluetooth speakers are built in.

Questions about the 20A outlet or the space? Text us before you order.

Shop the Fuji Text us

05

Free shipping, in a wooden crate, on a schedule

Shipping is free, always, in the continental US. The Fuji leaves our Ontario, California warehouse in a PeakGuard custom wooden crate.

In-stock orders ship within 2–4 business days. The carrier calls 1–2 days before delivery to set a 4-hour window.

06

Seven years of cover, and a club to go with it

Every Fuji has a 7-year residential warranty; full terms by component are published on the warranty page. Heating elements and cabinetry are covered for 7 years from delivery.

Peak Wellness Club is included free. It gives you expert protocols with the temperature, duration, timing and breathwork for each one, plus a leaderboard for your streak.
